title: River Development Agent Manifest Propagation Foundation
objective: Establish a deterministic, non-executing foundation for propagating an already-generated implementation manifest toward downstream production execution boundaries without creating, upgrading, synthesizing, broadening, or consuming execution authorization and without mutating the repository.

upstream: DEV-321 production execution authority input boundary foundation
DEV-322 production execution authority composition foundation
DEV-323 production execution authority orchestration integration
DEV-324 production execution authority operational entry integration
DEV-325 production execution authority implement command integration
context.architecturalFinding: Implementation manifests are already generated deterministically in memory. Manifest generation and artifact persistence are distinct concerns. DEV-326 must preserve that separation while establishing an explicit manifest propagation boundary.

requirements: Accept an already-generated implementation manifest through an explicit typed input boundary.
Preserve the manifest without altering its implementation identity, plan identity, branch, description, operations, content, overwrite semantics, or deterministic operation ordering.
Represent whether a manifest is available and eligible for downstream propagation.
Expose deterministic propagation state and blocked reasons.
Do not generate a new implementation manifest.
Do not write, modify, delete, rename, move, stage, commit, push, merge, or deploy repository content.
Do not execute implementation manifest operations.
Do not invoke shell commands or network operations.
Do not treat requested apply mode as authorization.
Do not upgrade, synthesize, broaden, or bypass existing authorization.
Provide focused tests proving propagation, blocked behavior, identity preservation, deterministic behavior, and non-mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: The DEV-326 manifest propagation foundation has an explicit typed input and result contract.
An available valid manifest is propagated without semantic mutation.
Missing or unavailable manifest input is represented as blocked rather than synthesized.
The original manifest identity and operation semantics are preserved.
Repeated identical inputs produce deeply equal results.
The foundation performs no repository writes.
The foundation creates, broadens, upgrades, synthesizes, bypasses, or consumes no authorization.
The complete River Dev test suite passes.
